_meta.purpose: controlled extractor enum -> EXACT training string. A wrong-case string (e.g. 'Ambulance') encodes to NaN and silently drops the model's 4th-strongest feature.
_meta.case_quirk: 'ambulance' is lowercase; Car/Walk-in/Public Transportation/Wheelchair/Other are capitalised.
_meta.not_stated: null / omit -> pass 'unknown' downstream (unknown_value=NaN); do NOT map to a real category.
_meta.unmapped_note: 'Police' is a real training arrivalmode with no enum value in the §4 controlled set; police-transport arrivals should map to 'other'. '<NA>' is the encoder's missing sentinel (code 0), not an arrival mode.
